input.overview: Caveman alternates between a conventional widebody playfield and its video maze. Enter the video game by reaching either long side vari-target or by shooting behind a drop-target bank. Deeper vari-target hits add more maze time. On the playfield, complete C-A-V-E to light an extra ball that must be collected in the maze, and finish drop-target banks to advance the end-of-ball multiplier from 2x through 5x. In the maze, eat the required dinosaurs while avoiding the red Tyrannosauruses, or escape through a door to return to pinball.
input.simpleOverview: Reach either side vari-target or shoot behind a drop-target bank to enter the video maze. Deeper vari-target hits add video time. Spell C-A-V-E to light an extra ball that is collected in the maze, and complete drop-target banks to build the 2x-through-5x bonus multiplier.
input.summary: Use the vari-targets when you want a longer video attempt; use the drop banks when multiplier progress matters more. Finish C-A-V-E before entering the maze if an extra ball is the priority.

quickInfo.name: Enter the Maze
quickInfo.summary: Reach a vari-target or shoot behind a drop bank.

steps.text: Choose a side vari-target for a timed video entry, or shoot behind either drop-target bank for a direct entry.
Before entering, complete C-A-V-E if you want the maze's extra-ball collect available.
In the maze, guide Caveman to the required dinosaurs, avoid the red Tyrannosauruses, and use a door when you want to return to the playfield.
Between maze attempts, complete drop-target banks to raise the end-of-ball multiplier through 2x, 3x, 4x, and 5x.

alternatives.title: Pinball-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the video controls are unfamiliar or the drop banks are nearly complete.

steps.text: Finish the most advanced drop bank for the next bonus multiplier.
Spell C-A-V-E, then use a vari-target to enter with more maze time.
Enter the video maze and collect the lit extra ball there.

machineSetup: Check video-screen brightness, joystick calibration, maze timing, extra-ball behavior, and whether progress carries between balls.
Test both vari-target depths, both drop-bank entry switches, C-A-V-E lamps, drop-bank resets, multiplier lamps, all four flippers, and the video-to-pinball return sequence.

playfieldReferences.label: Left maze vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: Long-range side target that enters the maze and can add video time.

playfieldReferences.label: Right maze vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: Matching side target used for maze entry and time.

playfieldReferences.label: Two four-target banks
playfieldReferences.description: Banks that advance Bonus X and can feed the video entry behind them.

playfieldReferences.label: C-A-V-E letters
playfieldReferences.description: Mid-playfield letters that light the maze extra ball.

techniques.name: Live Catch
techniques.instruction: After a video return, catch the served ball before choosing a narrow vari-target or bank shot.

cautions.issue: Caveman combines two control systems, and a weak or miscalibrated video section can change the value of every maze route.
cautions.response: Test the joystick and video handoff before relying on the extra-ball path.
